description: This script analyzes TypeScript source files within a project to detect channel-agnostic boundary violations, such as improper module imports, config references, or hardcoded channel identifiers, ensuring separation of concerns between channel-specific and channel-agnostic code.

methods.name: findChannelAgnosticBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Analyzes a given source content to identify violations related to channel-agnostic boundaries, such as import/export of channel modules, reference to channel config paths, comparisons with channel literals, and assignments to channel properties.

methods.name: findChannelCoreReverseDependencyViolations
methods.description: Wrapper around 'findChannelAgnosticBoundaryViolations' that checks for violations specific to channel core reverse dependencies.

methods.name: findAcpUserFacingChannelNameViolations
methods.description: Detects usage of channel names in user-facing strings that are not imported via module specifiers, violating separation of user-visible text from module logic.

methods.name: findSystemMarkLiteralViolations
methods.description: Detects hardcoded system mark literals (like ⚙️) in source content, which should be avoided for consistency or configurability reasons.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function coordinating the scanning of defined source groups for violations and reporting results.
